newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish shipbuilder Astander not at risk-minister.
newsitem.headline: Spanish shipbuilder Astander not at risk-minister.

text.p: Spanish Industry Ministy Josep Pique said on Tuesday that the future of state controlled shipbuilder Astilleros de Santander was not at risk.
"There's no risk for jobs in Astander now or in the future," Pique told reporters at a seminar.

Concern for the shipbuilder arose after the Spanish government agreed, as requested by the European Council of Ministers, that the shipyard would not carry out conversions as long as it remained in public owership. It may repair ships.
Astander is set to receive public investment of 1.29 billion pesetas in addition to 600 million envisaged under a strategic plan for competitiviness.
This is expected to allow Astander to reinforce its major repair activities and maintain jobs.
"The plan for shipyards has been completed entirely," said Pique.

"There has been a complex discussion in the European Union ..and Astander may not carry out, while in public ownership, conversion and it has to limit its activity to repairs. This affects around 20 percent of demand."
Later on Tuesday Pique will meet trade unions representing Astander's workers.
